name: events-scraper
what_it_holds: 'A Python PIP package to fetch events using Ticketmaster API.' MIT license, small (2 stars). No committed data; a thin client requiring a Ticketmaster Discovery API key (free-tier available) to pull concert/event listings by city/date.
why_useful: Lightweight, pip-installable Ticketmaster client that could be used to build a concert/event-density-by-city calendar as a demand-shock proxy for specific STR markets, complementing PredictHQ; low priority since it is a thin wrapper with no unique value over calling the Ticketmaster API directly.
themes: Event calendars: FIFA World Cup 2026 schedule and host-city data, Olympics, concerts (Setlist.fm, Songkick, Ticketmaster API), conferences, PredictHQ samples, holiday calendars by country

name: rgriff23/Olympic_history
what_it_holds: R scripts and compiled tabular data of Olympic athlete/event history 1896-2016, scraped from sports-reference.com; underlies the well-known Kaggle '120 years of Olympic history' dataset.
why_useful: Historical Olympics host-city/year reference (useful for base-rating how past Games moved host-city travel demand), but athlete/medal-level detail is not directly a travel-demand series and the dataset stops at 2016 (does not cover Tokyo 2020, Paris 2024, or Milano-Cortina 2026).
license: not confirmed (data originally scraped, redistributed for research use)

name: census-fema-tornadoes
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed how-to repo for pulling and integrating tornado-track data with FEMA disaster declarations and Census geography. Small project (0 stars), updated 9 Sep 2025.
why_useful: A worked example of joining disaster declarations to census geography, a pattern reusable for mapping any FEMA-declared hurricane/wildfire county to nearby Inside Airbnb / STR markets for gap 11.
themes: Weather, hurricanes, wildfires, disasters: NOAA/NHC tracks, EM-DAT, FEMA declarations, wildfire perimeters (Maui, LA fires), heatwaves; tourism-shock datasets
